title: Entity config
description: Validates config/entities/<entity>.yaml, the documentation home of a silver or gold entity (ADR-006, ADR-007). A `dbt` entity's model, contract and tests are generated from it by `python -m engine.dbt_models`. Rules a schema cannot express (keys and references name existing fields, SCD2 has valid_from_date) are checked in tests/unit/test_entity_configs.py.

version.description: Version of the entity config format.

entity.description: Entity name, the table name in its layer and the file name; the prefix tells the kind (docs/standards/naming.md).

description.description: Purpose of the entity and its lineage: sources and upstream entities.

grain.description: What one row means, in one sentence (docs/standards/data-modelling.md).

built_by.description: `dbt`: a model generated from this file; `engine`: built by the engine's Python (ops_run_log, DDL in src/engine/run_log.py).

input.description: Name of the staging model a `dbt` entity reads.

business_key.description: Fields of the business key. An SCD2 entity is keyed by these plus `valid_from_date` (ADR-004); every version is also unique on `known_at`.

scd2.description: True if every version of a record is kept with its `valid_from_date` (SCD2).

name.description: Column name, lower-case snake_case with the type suffix of docs/standards/naming.md.

required.description: True if the column is never null; generates a `not_null` test.

description.description: Meaning of the column, with its unit or currency if it has one.

allowed.description: The only values the column may hold; generates an `accepted_values` test.

references.description: `<entity>.<field>` that every value must exist in; generates a `relationships` test.
